title: Create a Theme: Your First Orchard Core Theme | Orchard Core
description:
A theme holds the layout, the templates and the static files that Orchard Core uses to render a site. Starting a theme from an empty folder means knowing which files Orchard Core expects and how it finds them.

The Orchard Core project templates package has a theme template that creates the project file, the manifest and the layout. This video generates a theme with dotnet new octheme, adds it to a solution, describes it in its manifest, and applies it from Design, Themes with Make Current.

In this video:
• What a theme is and what it holds
• Creating the theme project from the template
• What the template generates: the project file, the manifest and the layout
• Describing the theme: manifest values, thumbnail and static files
• Applying the theme from Design, Themes
• Where to go from here
